market_story: COAL_LIGNITE / COAL_PRB (2023): the real Luminant/sub-bit coal fleet two-shifted overnight in Aug-Oct 2023 - Oak Grove submitted a $60-class overnight RT offer top (measured 60-Day SCED, $60.26/$61.46) against ~$20 overnight LMPs, so SCED base-pointed the units to LSL every ordinary night and restored full output for the day; Martin Lake's +$1.9 Aug level step crossed the ~$21.3 overnight LMP and carries the sub-bit two-shift at the margin. The model now prices those measured year-2023 curves directly (verbatim submitted conduct, zero fitted parameters), so the LP's own dispatch reproduces the overnight backdown, the daytime recovery, and the Aug 15-19 scarcity-night pause (those nights priced >> $60) - price formation, not a floor, and no forced energy: the mustrun block stays owned by the ERCOT-137 measured margin, the peak tranche by ERCOT-140's gas-parity margin.
